highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 adds experimental image comparison APIs and fixes rendering and image-decoding behavior.
highlights_body: Runtime-effect uniforms start cleared, Windows x64 image error recovery no longer crashes, and Ganesh texture sampling stays inside subset edges. Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged.

breaking.title: Migrate Linux x86 deployments
breaking.body: Linux x86 native assets are no longer included in NuGet packages. Move 32-bit Linux deployments to a supported architecture, or remain on a release that provides linux-x86 assets.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Testing compares SKImage, SKBitmap and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets and error metrics, and creates difference images. The assembly is experimental: opt in to diagnostic SKIA4001 with NoWarn or a pragma. Results retain no native handles; callers own returned difference images.

New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers are cleared instead of exposing uninitialized values. Reset() now zeros the existing buffer in place rather than allocating a replacement, including when reusing mesh uniforms.

bullets.lead: Windows x64 image error recovery no longer crashes
bullets.detail: Fixes a crash in clang-built Windows x64 natives when JPEG or PNG decoding recovers from an error. This also affected PDF output containing lazy non-JPEG images and malformed JPEGs passed to SKCodec.Create. Windows ARM64, x86 and MSVC builds are unchanged.

Filtered texture-subset sampling clamps slightly inward to avoid reading undefined exterior texels. Ganesh also avoids direct linear copies at affected logical texture edges. Texture-edge pixels may change; CPU and Graphite rendering are unaffected.

bullets.lead: Tizen CPU blur selection takes effect
bullets.detail: Tizen now applies its intended CPU blur configuration to Skia, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the source change.

contributor_summaries.taublast: Fixed runtime-effect uniform initialization and in-place reset, and disposed test snapshots.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored the Uno Gallery and its view projects to the Windows sample solution.
contributor_summaries.SimonCropp: Fixed JPEG and PNG error-recovery crashes in clang-built Windows x64 natives.
